$comment: TruthGate credit-bureau protocol registry: which external-protocol events the bureau can consume as proven source-chain facts, with what parser, at what verification tier. Machine-readable source for the coverage table in docs. Evidence txs are real historical transactions on the live contract whose raw log bytes are pinned in contracts/test/MainnetParity.t.sol.

categories.DISCIPLINE: positive: proven debt repayment in an external protocol
categories.NEGATIVE: negative: proven liquidation of the subject

tiers.live-pipeline: consumed on CC3 today via attested Sepolia proofs (chainKey 1)
tiers.verified: parser parity-pinned against real logs of the verified live mainnet contract; consumable once that chain is attested
tiers.roadmap: registered target; parser not implemented yet

deployments.identity: ADDRESSES_PROVIDER 0x2f39d218133AFaB8F2B819B1066c7E434Ad94E9e, getMarketId() == "Aave Ethereum Market", getPool() round-trips (checked on-chain 2026-08-31)

protocols.name: Morpho Blue
protocols.parserNote: singleton contract, one address serves every market; event declarations from the canonical morpho-org/morpho-blue EventsLib (Id user-defined type == bytes32 in the ABI signature)

deployments.identity: address from docs.morpho.org; both topic0s confirmed against live emissions of this singleton (2026-08-31)
official Sepolia deployment per docs.morpho.org (morpho-blue v1.0.0, same source); code present on-chain — candidate for live-pipeline wiring

events.name: Repay
events.subject: onBehalf (topics[3]) — the borrower whose debt shrinks, not the paying caller

protocols.name: Compound v3 (Comet)
protocols.parserNote: one proxy per market (cUSDCv3, cWETHv3, ...) — the event is identical on each instance; cUSDCv3 is the registered flagship. NEGATIVE only by design: Comet has no repayment event — repaying is supply() into a negative balance, emitting the same Supply event as a lender's deposit, and the meaning depends on pre-transaction account state which an inclusion proof cannot attest. DISCIPLINE from Comet is unprovable in this model, not merely unimplemented (see the writeup in attestcoin-integration-summary.md).

deployments.identity: cUSDCv3 proxy from the canonical comet repo deployments/mainnet/usdc/roots.json; on-chain: baseToken() == canonical USDC, symbol() == "cUSDCv3" (checked 2026-08-31); no Ethereum testnet deployment exists in the comet repo (mainnet + L2s only)

events.name: AbsorbDebt
events.subject: borrower (topics[2]) — note the 3-topic shape, unlike the 4-topic Aave/Morpho liquidations

protocols.name: Rocket Pool
protocols.parserNote: amount is native ETH (msg.value) — the one external CAPITAL source homogeneous with vault deposits, so it enters the capped CAPITAL formula directly; draws from the JOINT capital cap (capital counted once across sources)

deployments.identity: resolved live from RocketStorage 0x1d8f8f00cfa6758d7bE78336684788Fb0ee0Fa46 via getAddress(keccak256("contract.address" || "rocketDepositPool")) (2026-08-31); Rocket Pool contracts are upgradeable — re-resolve after protocol upgrades. Primary testnet is Hoodi, not Sepolia — no testnet deployment registered

protocols.name: EigenLayer
protocols.parserNote: CURRENT slashing-era layout: Deposit(staker, strategy, shares) with NOTHING indexed — one topic, subject read from data. The pre-slashing 4-parameter layout (with a token field) produced zero logs in a 100k-block scan and is deliberately unsupported. Shares are heterogeneous LST strategy units -> flat per-event CAPITAL credit drawing from the JOINT capital cap: restaked LSTs cannot double-count capital already scored elsewhere

deployments.identity: StrategyManager proxy from the canonical Layr-Labs/eigenlayer-contracts deployments table (v1.13.0); 3-param Deposit layout confirmed against live emissions (2026-08-31)
official Sepolia StrategyManager (v1.12.1) per the canonical deployments table; code present on-chain — live-pipeline candidate (needs a whitelisted Sepolia strategy + LST to produce a real Deposit)

protocols.name: Maker / Sky
protocols.roadmapNote: LogNote/DSNote event model: core CDP operations emit anonymous events carrying raw calldata rather than typed indexed fields, so repay/liquidation semantics need a dedicated calldata-decoding adapter, not a log-layout parser. Documented as adapter roadmap; no addresses registered until the adapter design is verified against live logs.
